title: Slash footer
description: A tall dark footer: a serif wordmark beside five columns of grey links under white titles (two columns on phones), a row with the copyright, a cookie link, social icons and an outlined app badge over a hairline, then numbered small print paragraphs and an address in dim grey.
notes: social and app icons come in as props (lucide or your own)
name: slash-footer

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the company name, set as a serif wordmark

props.name: groups
props.description: link groups, each with a white title

props.name: cookies
props.description: a link beside the copyright ("Cookie settings")

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: social links: an icon each (e.g. from lucide) and an accessible label

props.name: app
props.type: { href: string; icon: ReactNode; small: string; big: string; }
props.description: the app download badge: an icon, a small top line and a bigger second line

props.name: legal
props.description: numbered footnotes and small print, one paragraph each

props.name: address
props.description: the company's name and address lines at the very end
